chain.speaker: Priya
chain.gist: Priya reports that the auditors require seven years of retention, which at the current growth means about 250 gigabytes, and that this would push the primary's backup window from 40 minutes to 95 minutes within three years, past the 60-minute maintenance window.
chain.option: an append-only table in the existing relational database, partitioned by month

chain.speaker: Kofi
chain.gist: Kofi objects that keeping seven years on the primary will break the backup window and slow down the failover tests.
chain.option: an append-only table in the existing relational database, partitioned by month

chain.speaker: Sofia

chain.speaker: Bashir
chain.gist: Bashir argues for keeping the table but exporting closed partitions nightly to object storage and holding only 90 days hot, since seven years in cold storage costs about 5 dollars a month and the auditors confirmed by email that checksummed exports in an open columnar file format are acceptable.
